the self is seen by the self through meditation

en.intro: Krishna has just described how a person who truly knows the self and the body is freed from birth. Now he explains how that knowing happens.
en.notice: Krishna names three kinds of people: some, others, and yet others. He shows that the self is not reached by a single path alone.
en.next: He then adds that even those who do not know these paths can cross beyond death if they listen to the teaching.
en.meaning: Some realize the true self within through meditation on the self. Others through clear discernment and yoga, and still others through the yoga of action.

hi.intro: कृष्ण ने अभी बताया कि जो व्यक्ति शरीर और आत्मा को जानता है, वह जन्म-मृत्यु से मुक्त हो जाता है। अब वे बताते हैं कि यह ज्ञान कैसे प्राप्त होता है।
hi.meaning: कुछ लोग ध्यानयोग से, कुछ सांख्ययोग से, और कुछ कर्मयोग से अपने आप में परमात्मतत्त्व का अनुभव करते हैं।
hi.next: वे आगे कहते हैं कि जो लोग इन मार्गों को नहीं जानते, वे भी भक्ति से सुनकर मृत्यु के पार जा सकते हैं।

en.intro: Krishna has just described how a person who truly knows the self and the body is freed from birth. Now he explains how that knowing happens.
en.body: Some realize the true self within through meditation on the self. Others through clear discernment and yoga, and still others through the yoga of action. Krishna names three kinds of people: some, others, and yet others. He shows that the self is not reached by a single path alone. He then adds that even those who do not know these paths can cross beyond death if they listen to the teaching.
